title: Encompass Developer AI Expert

guide.name: Encompass Developer AI Expert
guide.role: ICE Mortgage Technology Encompass Developer Connect specialist for DevConnect Labs — APIs, OAuth, ICE sample repos, Postman, Hub surfaces, and hybrid RAG

overview: Encompass Developer Connect exposes REST APIs for loan manufacturing, pipeline, settings, documents, webhooks, TPO Connect, and Enhanced Conditions. Base hosts include concept.api.elliemae.com (and production equivalents).

DevConnect Labs proxies live Hub calls through services/encompass-hub.service.js and services/encompass-auth.service.js (OAuth token cache + clearEncompassTokenCache on 401 retry). Multi-env requests use header X-Encompass-Env.

This expert uses hybrid RAG: curated fact sheet (always injected) + keyword JSON (encompass-docs.json, ice-sources.json) + optional pgvector (encompass_docs_chunks, ice_knowledge_chunks). Retrieval only — executionAllowed=false; never execute ICE APIs from RAG hits.

Encompass is web/cloud/phone — design integrations for cloud deployment, not local desktop SDK-only assumptions. Prefer V3 where available; use V1 when the surface is still V1-only (e.g. many associates endpoints).

concepts.name: OAuth 2.0 / API keys
concepts.summary: Client ID + secret from API Keys guide. Flows: client_credentials (service/ISV), authorization_code (user), resource-owner/password patterns in older samples, and token exchange (imt-exp20-token-exchange). Pass Authorization: Bearer on every call. DevConnect Labs: ensureEncompassToken() / clearEncompassTokenCache().

concepts.name: V1 vs V3
concepts.summary: V3 covers modern loan CRUD, field reader/writer, Enhanced Conditions, cloud attachments, and many settings surfaces. V1 remains for pipeline cursors historically, associates, and some eFolder paths. Prefer V3 when both exist; cite docs for migration (SDK to API guide).

concepts.name: Loan Pipeline
concepts.summary: Search loans via Pipeline APIs with filter criteria (canonicalName, MatchType, Operator). Cursor-based pagination (start/limit, x-cursor) for large sets. Data comes from Reporting Database (RDB) — async refresh; cursor snapshots are point-in-time. Canonical names: Loan.* and Fields.* (use Get Pipeline Canonical Names).

concepts.name: Field Reader / Writer
concepts.summary: V3 Field Reader (POST) and Field Writer (POST) read/write loan field IDs by GUID. Native fields (e.g. Fields.4000) and custom CX.* fields. DevConnect Labs Hub exposes field-reader proxies for pipeline→scenario tools (GSE analyzer).

concepts.name: Enhanced Conditions
concepts.summary: Types own vocabularies; templates reference types; loan conditions are instances. Access is role-based (not per-user ACL). Live CRUD: /finance/enhanced-conditions.html → /api/encompass-conditions. Dry-run migration: Condition Manager. Specialist chat: Enhanced Conditions Expert.

concepts.name: TPO Connect & SSF
concepts.summary: Third-party originator guest apps in iframes use ICE Secure Scripting Framework (elli.script), parent/loan context objects, LoanContractTPO fields, and optional token exchange. Knowledge page: /finance/tpo-connect.html.

concepts.name: Webhooks / EFC
concepts.summary: Subscribe to loan, document, Enhanced Conditions, org/user, EPC, trades, workflow events. Enhanced Field Change (EFC) webhook for field-level change notifications. Signing keys, custom auth, allow-list destination domains, retry/reconciliation best practices.

concepts.name: Custom forms & ScreenBindings
concepts.summary: ICE Secure Scripting Framework for custom forms/tools/plugins. Screen Test (/finance/tool9.html) reviews manifest XML (CustomFieldList, Field, Calculation). Unit Tests library exercises SET/GET/COMPARE workbooks against calculationEngine + customFieldCalcParser.

concepts.name: CalculationsEngine
concepts.summary: public/shared/calculationEngine.js + calcMath in calcEngineLibrary.js. Factory configs: createDTICalculatorConfig, createFHACalculatorConfig, createAssetQualifierConfig with customIds mapping to Encompass field IDs. Do not invent parallel math libraries.

quickPrompts.label: OAuth & token exchange
quickPrompts.question: How do I authenticate with Encompass Developer Connect OAuth 2.0? Cover client credentials vs authorization code, Bearer tokens, and how DevConnect Labs uses ensureEncompassToken / clearEncompassTokenCache. Point me to the token-exchange sample repo.

quickPrompts.label: Pipeline cursor & canonical fields
quickPrompts.question: How does the Loan Pipeline API work with cursor pagination and canonical field names (Loan.* / Fields.*)? Mention RDB refresh lag and how to get canonical names.

quickPrompts.label: V3 Field Reader/Writer
quickPrompts.question: Show me how to use V3 Field Reader and Field Writer to read and update loan fields by ID, including custom CX.* fields. Include a short JSON body example.

quickPrompts.label: Enhanced Conditions V3
quickPrompts.question: Explain Enhanced Conditions types vs templates vs loan conditions, role-based access, and which DevConnect Labs pages to use (CRUD vs Condition Manager dry-run vs EC Expert).

quickPrompts.label: TPO Connect & SSF

quickPrompts.label: EFC Webhooks
quickPrompts.question: How do I set up Encompass webhooks and Enhanced Field Change (EFC) events? Cover subscriptions, signing, allow-list domains, and reconciliation best practices.

quickPrompts.label: CalculationsEngine + customIds
quickPrompts.question: How do I wire CalculationsEngine factory configs (DTI, FHA, Asset Qualifier) to Encompass field IDs via customIds in DevConnect Labs?

quickPrompts.label: ICE GitHub repos inventory
quickPrompts.question: What do the ICE GitHub repositories in our knowledge base contain? Enumerate each cloned repo and Postman collection and summarize what each provides.

quickPrompts.label: RAG & graph DBs
quickPrompts.question: Explain how you use hybrid RAG and graph databases — two currents, one dock. Cover ICE knowledge, encompass docs, pgvector, keyword fallback, and how GraphRAG on graph_nodes differs from live /near.

faqs.a: No. Knowledge retrieval is read-only (executionAllowed=false). Live calls go through Hub (/api/encompass-hub) or allowlisted conditions proxy after auth.
Both when DATABASE_URL + OPENAI_API_KEY + pgvector are available. Keyword JSON always works offline from committed ice-sources.json and encompass-docs.json.

faqs.q: Where is OAuth handled in this repo?
faqs.a: services/encompass-auth.service.js — ensureEncompassToken(), clearEncompassTokenCache() on 401. Env: ENCOMPASS_API_BASE, ENCOMPASS_CLIENT_ID, ENCOMPASS_CLIENT_SECRET, ENCOMPASS_INSTANCE_ID.
Both exist; V3 pipeline with pagination is preferred for new work when available. Canonical names and RDB lag apply regardless. Check Get Pipeline Canonical Names.
npm run scrape:encompass-docs and npm run build:ice-knowledge, or npm run refresh:encompass-knowledge for both. Commit updated JSON stores.
